items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: it was mostly Guy Lombardo and Wayne King, there was one Harry James 78 there you know. But I had no clue who Harry James was.

ctx.x: I was going to say it sounds exactly like something I would say. I get so perturbed sometimes you know, and you know I guess I probably, I don’t mean to be an elitist or anything about this music, but I care more about this music than I could even, you know, with all the dictionaries that I own and everything I don’t think I could come up with the words to express my, the depth of my emotional feelings for this music. It’s not just music to me, it’s something greater than that. It’s religion, it’s philosophy,…
Right. You didn’t think of this is like really sweet stuff.
